description:
Your hiking companion and GPS track manager. Open to all your outdoor activities: hiking, trail running, cycling, ski touring, walking…
Free and open source, no ads, no trackers — your data stays yours.
On Android and the Web.
Plan, record, organize, analyze and share your trails:
• Offline maps
• IGN, OSM basemaps, …
• Import / export GPX
• Trail printing
• Geotagged photos
• Elevation profile
• Tags & collections
• Search & filters
• Live group tracking
• Waypoints
• Web ↔ Android sync
• Sharing & links
• Estimated walking time
• Path waymarking
• Trail markers
• Path surfaces & types
• Distance & time remaining
• Trail creation
• Map rotation
• Track editor
• and much more…
And an open trail database, documented and verified, to build together.
